title: Latest versions of three Python HTTP libraries

turns.prompt: Find the latest released versions of the Python packages requests, httpx and aiohttp. Write a markdown table to {D}/compare.md with columns package, latest version, source URL. Then tell me the three versions.
turns.verify: f={D}/compare.md; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no compare.md; exit 0; }; sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f | head -30; grep -qi requests $f && grep -qi httpx $f && grep -qi aiohttp $f && echo PASS || echo FAIL: a package is missing

rubric.criteria: Table has the three packages with plausible current version numbers and a real source URL per row. The file write and the lookups are verified programmatically (verify script); do not fail for them not being 'shown' in the reply.

regression: ; run 13: judge failed a correct answer for not 'showing' the write — verify covers it
